item_description:
Script: 'bru tsha.
Lines per folio: 10; 3 on fol. 48b.
Orthography:
- bindu for -m
- abbreviations (e.g., for slob dpon, thams cad, etc.)
- Numerals used for numbers and phonetic value
Annotations with "+" signs and dotted lines on fols. 21b1, 28a1, 29b1, 35a1, 37a1,, 38a1, 40a9, etc.
Numbers in annotations on fols. 36b10-37a1 to count items in a list.
Numbers in the top margin on fol. 40a.
Proofread (1 zhus dag par byas so).
